info.name: Safety & Violations API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Safety & Violations system (Project / ProjectType module).

Base path: {{base_url}}/api/v1/projects

Auto-Creation:
- When a ProjectNotification is published (POST /api/v1/projects/notifications or PUT to publish a draft), a pending SafetyRecord is automatically created for each user in assigned_user_ids.
- When a published notification is updated with new assigned users, SafetyRecords are created for the new users only (idempotent).
- When a notification task is reassigned (reassignTask), pending SafetyRecords for removed users are deleted and new ones are created for newly assigned users. Completed records are preserved.

Manual Workflow:
1. GET /violations — load the violations catalog
2. POST /{project_id}/safety — manually create a safety task (one SafetyRecord per assigned user)
3. GET /safety/inbox — assigned user sees pending tasks
4. GET /{project_id}/safety/{safety_id} — view task + all_violations
5. POST /{project_id}/safety/{safety_id}/violations — evaluate violations (marks completed)
6. PUT /{project_id}/safety/{safety_id} — update metadata (blocked when completed)
7. DELETE /{project_id}/safety/{safety_id} — delete pending task (blocked when completed)

Required headers on every request:
- Accept: application/json
- Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
- X-Tenant: {{tenant_id}}

variable.description: UUID of ProjectNotification (or set to integer id when morphable_type=project_order_permit)

item.name: 1. Violations Catalog
item.description: Global violations lookup used when creating/evaluating safety records.

request.description:
GET /api/v1/projects/violations

Returns the full violations catalog ordered by code.
Use violation `id` values when creating or evaluating safety records.

response.name: Success — Violations List

item.name: 2. Safety Inbox
item.description: Assigned-user inbox. Returns pending safety tasks for the authenticated user.

request.description:
GET /api/v1/projects/safety/inbox

Returns pending safety records assigned to the authenticated user (`status = pending`).
Must be registered before `/{project}/safety/{id}` to avoid UUID route conflicts.

request.description:
POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/safety/{id}/violations

Assigned user evaluates violations.
Syncs pivot (`weight`, `status`) and sets record status to `completed`.

Send as multipart/form-data. Optionally attach up to 3 evidence images via `images[]` (jpg, jpeg, png, webp — max 5MB each). Uploaded images are stored in the `violation_evidence` media collection and returned in the `evidence` array of the response.

Allowed status values:
- violation_found
- no_violation
- not_applicable

Only the assigned user may call this endpoint.
